description.id: Kernel Go Framework tangguh berarsitektur Clean Architecture dengan adapter HTTP agnostic (Fiber/Gin/Chi), Dependency Injection native, dan Resiliency Circuit Breaker built-in.
description.en: Resilient Go core framework engineered around Clean Architecture principles with framework-agnostic HTTP adapters (Fiber/Gin/Chi), native DI, and built-in Circuit Breaker resilience.

description.id: Perangkat CLI untuk scaffolding proyek Clean Architecture otomatis, pembuat modul Domain/Usecase/Repository, serta live hot-reloading dev server.
description.en: Powerful CLI tool for automatic Clean Architecture project scaffolding, Domain/Usecase/Repository module generation, and live hot-reloading dev server.

description.id: Skrip instalasi otomatis lintas platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) untuk mengunduh biner Rancago CLI dan dependensi lingkungan dalam satu perintah.
description.en: Cross-platform zero-dependency automated installer script (Linux, macOS, Windows) to provision Rancago binaries and toolchain in one single command.

description.id: Repositori resmi forum Q&A, diskusi teknis, tanya arsitektur, usulan fitur, dan pengumuman ekosistem Rancago.
description.en: Official repository dedicated to technical Q&A, architectural discussions, feature requests, and Rancago ecosystem announcements.
